base_row_version.title: Base Row Version

EntitlementValue.title: EntitlementValue

Body for destructive / sensitive actions: a recorded reason and a typed confirmation of the
target (e.g. the organization slug), so a stray click or replayed request cannot trigger them.
Sensitive.title: Sensitive

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated; repeats return the same session
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

node_id.description: Destination workspace node (required for a new document)
node_id.title: Node Id

target_document_id.description: Set to upload a NEW VERSION of this document
target_document_id.title: Target Document Id

WorkspaceSetup.description:
Optional starting workspace for a new company: blank (default), a template version, or a copy of another company's
configuration (never its documents, users or permissions). Everything stays editable and independent afterwards.
WorkspaceSetup.title: WorkspaceSetup

info.description: Shared cloud backend. Tenant realm: /api/v1/*. Platform realm: /api/v1/platform/*.
info.title: Artify Co-Accountant API

post.description: The invitee refuses. The link stops working and the organization sees the invitation as declined.

get.description:
Closing status of every visible company for one day (default: each company's own today). Status and counts only:
no transactions, documents or amounts.

patch.description:
Edit the company PROFILE (names, registration, contact). Accounting settings have their own endpoint and
permission; lifecycle (archive, restore, activate, deactivate) has its own too.

post.description: Set up the company's own accounting profile (once). Nothing is copied from another company.

get.description: Suggested existing contacts for a name / tax number. Suggestions only; nothing is linked or merged.

post.description: Rates are entered (or loaded from a configured source) and never overwritten or invented.
A manual journal draft (a journal-type transaction). It follows the same review and approval workflow.
Re-run the balance and posting checks for the journal's transaction and return the result.
Rules are data (fixed fields, operators and actions), versioned and audited. There is no scripting.
Record that a qualified person reviewed this tax code. Artify never marks a code verified by itself.
Copy a sample chart of accounts into this company (independent copy; only into an empty chart).
Copy a starter tax pack (configuration, not advice). It stays UNVERIFIED until a person records a review.
A hand-made draft. Validation runs immediately and is stored with the draft.
Draft(s) from an extraction an accountant has APPROVED. Bank statements create one draft per confirmed row.
Reverse the approved transaction and open a corrected draft copy.

put.description: Confirm (or clear) the customer/supplier. Suggested matches are never applied automatically.
Edit the proposed journal by hand. The backend still validates balance, accounts, tax, period and currency.

get.description: Who was assigned, changed or removed, by whom and when (from the append-only audit log).

patch.description:
Change type, responsibility or the assignment window. Setting `ends_on` in the past ends the person's access to
the company from that day; the row stays as history of who was assigned.

post.description: COPY a default template into this company. The copy is the company's own; it never follows the template.
Approve and close. The day is validated again at this moment and an immutable snapshot is stored.
A daily report for the day through the Excel engine (approved data unless explicitly allowed otherwise).
Keeps the original closing and snapshot and returns a NEW, linked closing for the same day.

get.description: The stored snapshot with a live re-check of its hash. Snapshots can only be read, never changed.
The workbench overview for one business day (a calendar day in the company's own time zone). Real data only.
Every closing snapshot the day ever had, oldest first. A reopened day keeps its original.
What a validation would find right now. Nothing is stored.
Whether every day that needs a closing has one. An overview only: it locks no period and prepares no VAT return.

post.description: A device DECLARES its local synchronisation state for a day. It is shown as declared, never as proof.
Move a task along its status graph. Who may do which move (assignee, manager, an independent reviewer) is decided on the server.

get.description:
The record that OWNS this company's configuration. Phase 4 attaches workspace structure, categories,
folders, fields, templates, workflows and folder mappings to it; in Phase 3 it only says nothing is configured.

Search/filter/sort/paginate the documents the caller may see. Archived and deleted documents are listed only
when asked for. Results never include documents in locations the caller cannot view.
Document counts per workspace node (own and including subfolders) for tree badges.

post.description: Pre-check before uploading: identical content already in THIS company (never other companies).
Advisory filing and naming suggestion from the company's own rules. Nothing is filed or renamed.

Register an upload. Nothing is stored yet; the response says where to send the bytes. Replaying the same
`idempotency_key` returns the existing session (HTTP 200); a new session answers 201.

patch.description:
Resumable upload: send the file in consecutive chunks (raw body). Ask `GET …/uploads/{op}` for `received_bytes` after
any interruption and continue from there. A wrong `offset` answers 409 `offset_mismatch` with the offset to use. When the
last byte arrives the whole file is hashed and validated exactly like a one-shot upload; until the final answer the
upload is not a success (and is never a document before `complete`). Optional `X-Chunk-SHA256` checks the chunk itself.

parameters.description: Byte offset of this chunk; must equal `received_bytes`
parameters.name: offset

schema.description: Byte offset of this chunk; must equal `received_bytes`
schema.title: Offset

post.description:
Verify the stored object and create the document (or the new version). Idempotent: completing twice returns the
same result. The upload is a success only when this call returns 200.

put.description:
Stream the file bytes (raw body, `application/octet-stream`). The server hashes and size-checks as it reads,
validates the real content, scans (when a scanner is configured) and stores the object. The answer carries the
session; a rejected file answers 4xx with `operation.status` = failed | quarantined and the reason in `code`.

post.description: Re-open a transiently failed upload (storage or scanner unavailable). The file is sent again from the start.

delete.description: Permanent deletion (irreversible). Only from the deleted items, never under hold; `confirm=true` is required.

get.description:
Stream the original bytes. Authorization is checked on every request and the access is recorded. Only formats
that render without executing anything (PDF, PNG, JPEG, BMP) may be shown inline; everything else downloads.

post.description: Soft delete: the document moves to the deleted items and can be restored. Bytes stay in storage.

get.description: Every extraction version of the document (earlier ones are kept when it is reprocessed).

post.description: Retention / legal hold: a held document cannot be permanently deleted.

get.description: Latest job, classification and extraction of a document in one call (what the review screen opens with).

post.description: Re-file a document. Only the database changes; the stored bytes are never moved.

get.description: Recognised text with line boxes and confidences, a few pages at a time.
The page as it was read (rotation/deskew applied): the surface source boxes refer to. Streamed, never a public URL.

post.description:
Queue OCR + classification + extraction for the document's CURRENT version. Repeating the request (same key, or a
job already running for this version) returns the existing job (HTTP 200) instead of creating a duplicate.

get.description: Governed datasets, fields, filters, header values and the safe calculation list. There is no free-form SQL.

post.description:
Queue an export. The file exists only when `status` becomes `completed` (validated and stored). The same idempotency
key returns the first export (HTTP 200).

get.description: Authorized download. Every download is audited; the recorded checksum is returned in `X-Export-Sha256`.

post.description: A new, separately recorded export with the same template version, mapping and parameters; the original is untouched.
Real approved data through the same mapping code the export uses (no file is created).

put.description:
Register a workbook (raw body) as a new template, or as a new version of `template_id`. The file is size-capped while
streaming, inspected without executing anything, analysed and stored; macros are refused unless the plan allows them.

post.description: Save a draft. Drafts may be incomplete; the response carries the validation result.

Approval is a human act: it needs the approval permission, `edit` on the document's folder, and every flagged item
resolved. Nothing here creates accounting entries.
Add a transaction the reader missed. It is marked as manually added and counts in the balance checks.
File the document where the suggestion says — through the normal move operation, so every Phase 6 rule applies.

get.description: Creation, modification, lifecycle, settings, assignment and membership events of this company.

patch.description:
Edit this company's accounting settings. They never propagate to, or inherit from, another company or the
organization. The base currency can only change while nothing has been configured for the company (later
phases will attach data denominated in it).

post.description:
Activate / deactivate / archive / restore. Nothing is deleted: archived companies keep all their data and
free their subscription slot; restoring needs a free slot again.

get.description:
What changed in this company after `cursor` (oldest first), limited to what the caller may see. Time comes from the
database, never from a device. Re-reading with `overlap_seconds` is safe: items are idempotent by (kind, id, revision).

post.description: For items a client holds with the revision it last saw: current, stale, locked or missing, and why.
A client reports that it could not write an item. The server verifies the claim; `no_conflict` if the item is current.
Record the decision. It does not write the record: apply_local/merged return `next_base_revision` to send with the write.

get.description: Open conflicts the caller can see, counted by kind. Server-derived (unlike the numbers a device reports about itself).
The caller's view of one company's workspace: only nodes they may view, with what they may do on each.

post.description:
Copy another company's CONFIGURATION (structure, categories, fields, naming and filing rules). Never documents,
users, permissions or money. The copy is independent immediately.
Validate document metadata against the fields that apply to a category/folder. Nothing is stored.
Dry run: which rule would win for these attributes? Nothing is filed or moved (that arrives with documents).

Render a file name with sample values. Storage and overwriting are Phase 6; this only shows what the rule would
produce. The original file name is returned separately and never altered.
Explain what another member could do (administrators use it to verify a configuration).

Bring structure, categories, fields and rules back to a recorded revision WITHOUT deleting anything (later items
are archived). Permission grants are not restored. `dry_run` reports the effect and changes nothing.

Deep-copy a template version into this company with new ids. The company keeps only a provenance note: later
template changes never reach it.

get.description:
Distribution contract for Desktop/Mobile: ONLY active, non-archived targets the caller may upload to, with the
categories that file there. Nothing is hard-coded; an empty workspace returns empty lists.

post.description:
Bind the caller's CURRENT session to one of their own ACTIVE devices and record activity (also the heartbeat).
A revoked or foreign device answers 404, so a revoked installation cannot re-attach a new session to itself.

get.description: Templates, recent exports and usage across the organization's companies. No file content and no downloads here.

patch.description: Change your own display name or language. E-mail and roles are not editable here.

post.description: Needs the current password. Every OTHER session of the user is signed out; this one continues.

patch.description:
Edit the basic profile (display name, locale). Legal identity, type, country, currency and
status are not editable here: they change through Super Admin / support processes.

get.description:
Professional staff (accountant, assistant accountant, staff) with their assigned companies and workload.
The professional profile (job title, licence) is separate from the authorization role shown in `role`.
Assignment lists show only companies the viewer may see.

Organization activity (the customer's own audit log). Platform-internal logs are never part of it; Artify
support activity appears here only because it is mirrored into the customer's log (see support policy).

All company-accountant assignments the viewer may see, filterable by company, person and whether the
assignment window is currently open.

Recompute the organization's audit hash chain (Phase 12). `ok` is true when every sealed event still matches its seal and
the chain is unbroken. `head_hash` should be copied to a place outside the database to detect removal of the newest seals.
`unsealed_recent` counts events of the last 7 days the sealing job has not reached yet (they are not yet protected).

post.description:
Create a company with its profile, its OWN accounting settings, its configuration-ownership record and
(optionally) its first accountant assignments, atomically. Nothing is copied from the organization or from
another company, and no default sections, folders or categories are created.

get.description:
Searchable, filterable, paginated company directory. `status=open` means active or inactive (not archived).
Rows are limited by row-level security to the companies the caller may see.

post.description: Issue a NEW secret link (the old one stops working) and a fresh expiry for a pending invitation.

patch.description:
Change a member's status and/or role. Safety rules: only a firm owner may grant or remove
the firm-owner role; the last firm owner can neither be demoted nor deactivated; nobody changes
their own role; roles that count against limit.accountants are guarded; assignments end when a
member stops being an accountant/staff member.

Professional details (job title, phone, licence). They are descriptive only and never grant or limit access:
the organization role does. A person may edit their own; `member_profiles.manage` edits anyone's.

post.description:
The approved way to hand an organization over: the current owner (MFA-verified, typing the organization slug)
makes another ACTIVE member the firm owner and becomes a practice administrator in the same transaction. The
organization therefore never has zero owners, and the last owner can never be removed any other way.

patch.description:
Organization-level contact, regional and notification settings. These never overwrite any company's own
currency, financial year, VAT or configuration (each company owns those). The organization's name, display
name and language are changed through `PATCH /orgs/{id}` (owner only).

get.description:
The organization's plan, status and entitlements exactly as the platform configured them. Customers cannot
change any of it; limits are enforced by the backend, never by this page.

post.description: Save a company's workspace (or a supplied definition) as a reusable organization template. Configuration only.

get.description:
One time-ordered feed of platform-level events: registrations, subscription changes, administrative
actions and support requests.
Sign-ins and actions performed by one administrator (from the append-only platform audit).

post.description: Signed manual adjustment (credit < 0, debit > 0) with a mandatory reason. The invoice total is never edited.
Record money Artify actually received (entered by an administrator). Overpayment is rejected.

get.description:
Every key plans can configure. `enforced_now` is false for keys whose feature does not exist yet:
the value can be set today and starts being enforced when the feature ships.

post.description: Suspension makes the organization read-only (Phase 1 behaviour); data is preserved.
A deactivated plan cannot be assigned to new subscriptions; existing ones are unaffected.
Publish a new immutable version. Existing subscriptions keep the version they use.
The requester can always withdraw their own request/grant; revoking someone else's needs platform.support.revoke.

get.description:
Usage against limits per organization. Current values are the maintained usage counters; metrics that
are not metered yet show as such. Scans at most 500 organizations per request.
Counts and lists from real job records. Shows names and statuses only, never document content.
Provider state and the organization's choices. Secrets are never returned: only whether a provider is configured.
Storage used against the plan, per-company breakdown, scanner/backend status and recent failures.

post.description:
Compare database and object store. Read-only unless `repair` is true (marks lost objects `missing`, removes
orphan objects older than `min_age_seconds`, expires abandoned upload sessions).
